verdict.rationale: Codegen documents creating and managing many agents programmatically through the API, SDK and CLI, listing agent runs, and running work in isolated environments. One API endpoint can 'stop all related agents' for a PR, which implies several agents run at once. However, no evidence explicitly describes running tasks in parallel or scaling throughput. Missing for 10: an explicit concurrency or parallel-run capability, documented concurrency limits or quotas, orchestration for fanning tasks out across agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel execution at scale.
